title: Influence of Weightlessness on Baroreflex Function
archive_status: Data preservation is complete. All datasets are publicly available.
notes: Downloaded: tabular files (xls/xlsx/csv/txt) and PDF reports up to 50 MB. Every Excel sheet is also saved as '<file>__<sheet>.csv' (raw cell grid, no header detection).
Not downloaded: figure images (tif/jpg) - they are rendered graphs; their URLs are listed under skipped_files.
Downloaded files are untrusted data: parse only, never open macros / execute.
Only group-level summaries (mean +/- SE). No per-subject data. Not importable to observation; usable as reference/cohort statistics.
The archive lists every file 7 times (one copy per mission dataset, different file keys, identical bytes) - only one copy stored, others listed in skipped_files as duplicates.
Missions: see 'missions' field; 'Detailed Supplementary Objectives', EDOMP Final Report 1989-1995.

files/JMDSO_467_5/JMDSO_467_5.xls.what: Measurements from all subjects on all test days (stand test + carotid baroreflex)
files/JMDSO_467_5/JMDSO_467_5.xls.granularity: group mean ± SE (single text cell like '116 ± 2' or '1,123 ± 42*')
files/JMDSO_467_5/JMDSO_467_5.xls.subjects: 11-12 (footnote: LD vs preflight n=11; LD vs R+8-10 n=12)

rows.name: Carotid distending pressure at min/max R-R

pitfalls: Values are text 'mean ± SE' with significance markers (*, †) and thousands separators ('1,123').
SOURCE ERROR: the 'Maximum slope, ms/mmHg' row repeats the 'Body weight, kg' row verbatim (75.6 ± 4.0 ...) - do not use it.
Transposed layout: variables in rows, time points in columns.

files/JMDSO_467_6/JMDSO_467_6.xls.what: Subjects grouped (cluster analysis) into 'more resistant' vs 'less resistant' to orthostatic stress; supine and standing BP, HR, R-R, baroreflex
files/JMDSO_467_6/JMDSO_467_6.xls.granularity: group mean ± SE per resistance group
pitfalls: Text 'mean ± SE' cells; '931 ±10' without space; empty spacer column between L-10 and R+0 blocks.

files.dataset_description:
This Excel file contains cardiovascular parameters from all subjects for the DSO 467 study. Variables include blood pressure (supine and standing), heart rate (supine and standing), R-R interval (supine and standing), body weight, age, maximum slope, and operational point.

Source: Extended Duration Orbiter Medical Project (EDOMP) Final Report 1989-1995.

This Excel file contains measurements from all subjects for the DSO 467 study. Variables include blood pressure, R-R interval, body weight, maximum slope, operational point, and carotid distending pressure.

Source: Extended Duration Orbiter Medical Project (EDOMP) Final Report 1989-1995.

The hatched area indicates a more resistant group.
